generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: Try again. If it happens again, save a project file and report the problem.

storageFull: This browser's storage is full, so your project wasn't saved here. Save a project file to keep it.
copyFailed: We couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
downloadBlocked: Your browser blocked the download. Allow downloads for this site, then try again.
offlineUrl: You seem to be offline. Files on your computer still work.

engine.internal: Unexpected error in the background task.
engine.invalidParams: These settings are out of range.

storage.blocked: This browser doesn't let the site store data, so your project won't be kept after a reload. Save a project file to keep it.
